name: Life in Weeks
shortDescription: Your life as a grid of weeks, lived ones filled, a poster you can print.
description:
Life in Weeks lays a whole life out as ninety rows of fifty-two squares, one square for every week. The weeks you have lived are filled, sweeping in from the top-left corner when the page opens, and this week's square pulses once a second.

The chapters of your life sit behind the grid as tinted bands, school, a city, a first job, each named in the left margin in a display serif. The days that mattered are marked squares with a hairline running out to a word in the right margin. Hover any square to see its dates and how old you were, or will be.

Press Print and the page becomes a poster in A2, A3, A4, or Letter: your name and birthdate above, the grid centered, a line of your choosing below, and the eras as a key. Choose paper, bone white with the weeks in ink, or ink, black with the weeks in bone. On a phone the grid fills the screen; on a desktop the whole life fits at once.
setup: What's your birthdate? What three to six eras would you mark, with their years (school, a city, a job)? Any single dates to flag? A line for the bottom of the poster?
